card.name: Last piece of brand drug names
card.fires_on: The final piece of an invented capitalized brand drug name, such as IQ, X or K, in label text. It also fires on the end of a username or title in web text.

modes.label: Brand name endings
modes.description: The last piece of an all-caps brand drug name split into several parts.
modes.example: OLINVY<<K>> may reduce respiratory drive, and the resultant

modes.label: Web name endings
modes.description: The inside or end of a social handle or a title in general web text.
modes.example: Follow Zerlina Maxwell on Twitter at @zerlin<<amax>>well

card.writes: The promoted tokens are unrelated name pieces, so it adds no clear output effect beyond a sense that a proper name is finishing.
card.plain: It marks the last syllable of a made-up brand drug name, such as PALYNZIQ or OLINVYK.
